name: Ane to Imo
source:
This is a short story about two sisters who are in love with each other.

Elder sister cannot refuse the favors that her sadistic younger sister asks her.
Younger sister's friends join the party and the situation becomes like an orgy.

[edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045159.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于两姐妹相爱的短篇故事。

姐姐无法拒绝虐待狂妹妹向她提出的要求。
妹妹的朋友们加入了聚会，气氛变得像一场狂欢。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045159.html]DLsite English[/url]]
